reading.body:
CyrusOne Totowa holds 6 MW of IT capacity in a 200,000 square-foot facility in northern New Jersey, translating to roughly 150 racks at typical AI training density.

This facility ranks fourth among the five New Jersey data centers with published power specifications, accounting for 5.4% of the state's announced 111.3 MW of IT capacity. New Jersey has 48 mapped data center facilities overall, but operators disclose power for only five of them. The disclosed base is sparse enough that individual facility specifications move the state-level total measurably.

The campus sits in the densest data center region in the United States, where power access and grid headroom are heavily contested resources. Six megawatts is modest against hyperscale standards, but it represents a claim on constrained regional power supply. The lack of published expansion plans for this facility leaves unclear whether CyrusOne intends to grow the Totowa campus or hold it at current size.
